name: shopee-price-tracker
description: Local-first Shopee Vietnam variant price tracker.

scripts.format: prettier --write apps/server apps/extension packages/shared scripts tests/unit tests/integration *.json *.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/server apps/extension packages/shared scripts tests/unit tests/integration *.json *.mjs
